info.title: B033 explicit local-dev sync foundation
info.description: O06/O07 plus local manifest/changefeed prerequisites for C11. Routes absent by default. Only registered five metadata kinds; no client ACK/gate application, product adapter, public auth, B080/offline byte readiness or future resource copy enablement. Conflict pages are bounded live lists, snapshot=false; reconciliation pages are immutable action plans with optional full metadata manifest bindings.

parameters.description: Exact configured local-dev origin and fresh CSRF bootstrap required.
